name: }IDE.SaveDataAll
description: Hidden core fallback for servers whose REST API has no tm1.SaveDataAll action. Writes all changed cube data to disk. Admin-only by policy; exposed through the IDE Save data button and the save_data_all MCP tool, not as a raw process.
prolog:
#Region }IDE.SaveDataAll
# Fallback for servers without POST /api/v1/tm1.SaveDataAll.
# SaveDataAll writes all changed cube data to disk and pauses the server briefly.
SaveDataAll;
#EndRegion
